description: Returns a list of album reviews with possible fields such as the number of agreements (agreecnt), the user-assigned score, review text and title. The only mandatory parameter is client_id; other parameters are optional and allow pagination, formatting, sorting and filtering of results.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wrap the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 200; keyword 'all' is limited to 200).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the given field(s). Append _asc or _desc for direction; ascending is default.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, response includes a results_fullcount header with the total number of rows without pagination.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Two‑letter language code of the review (e.g., "en", "fr").

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Closed interval filter for review dates in the form "YYYY-MM-DD_YYYY-MM-DD".

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: OAuth2 access token for the Jamendo user; required only for user‑specific data.

parameters.name: hasscore
parameters.description: Filter reviews that have (or do not have) a score.

responseFields.name: agreecnt
responseFields.description: Number of agreements on the review.

notes: client_id is mandatory for all calls.
access_token is optional; include it when you need user‑specific information.
order fields can be suffixed with _asc or _desc; default is ascending.
limit capped at 200 even when using "all".
fullcount may impact performance and is not available on heavy methods.
